notes.title: Version 1.0.2 has arrived with the new year
notes.notes:
I have been working mainly on my new game (from which I do not plan on giving details during this year, but we'll see how it evolves), but I decided to take the time to vary and make an update. This update contains:

-Addition of Japanese as an eligible language (probably not a very good translation, but I plan to improve it as I progress in my studies of the language and eases that I can incorporate others such as Portuguese or German; but have patience :P)
-Incorporation of bases for "metaplayability" (there is no precise term for this, so I coined that one). I also prefer not to give details about it for now, but it would connect my new game with this one (being both very different from each other)
-Improved performance and synchronization

I take this opportunity to wish you a good year and am eager to read your suggestions
Take care ;)

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is live :D
notes.notes:
After a break of 10 months I'm back with a little update:

-2 new backgrounds have been added
-A brand new power called "Shot" has been added
-An undiscovered bug has been found and deleted

Hope you enjoy it and I'm eager to read your suggestions
Take care ;)
